SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN D.WIDTH * D.HEIGHT < 921690 THEN M.META_ID END) AS hd_meta_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN D.WIDTH * D.HEIGHT BETWEEN 921690 AND 2073600 THEN M.META_ID END) AS fhd_meta_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN D.WIDTH * D.HEIGHT BETWEEN 2073600 AND 3686400 THEN M.META_ID END) AS qhd_meta_cnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN (D.WIDTH * D.HEIGHT > 3686400) THEN M.META_ID END) AS fk_meta_cnt FROM DATA D JOIN META M ON D.DATA_ID = M.DATA_ID WHERE (D.WIDTH IS NOT NULL AND D.HEIGHT IS NOT NULL) AND DATASET_ID = #{dataset_id}
AND LABEL = #{label}
SELECT LABEL AS "label" FROM META AS MT JOIN DATA AS DT ON MT.DATA_ID = DT.DATA_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DT.DATASET_ID = #{dataset_id} GROUP BY LABEL ORDER BY LABEL
